The '''Lortans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Lorta/Legends|Lorta]]. They were known to be violent and expansionist.

==History==
The group believed that someday a Man-[[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] would sweep evil from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
Approximately ten years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] they sent a battle fleet into twelve systems and virtually wiped out every planet, including the [[Jiroch system/Legends|Jiroch system]], in a genocide known as the [[Reslian Purge]].
The Lortans were finally stopped by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in a series of battles in which [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] participated.
